mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_room (title, place_id, user_id, user_nickname, user_profile) VALUES ( #{title}, #{placeId}, #{userId}, #{userNickname}, COALESCE(#{userProfile}, '/default-profile.png') );
INSERT INTO chat_room_user (chat_room_id, user_id, joined_at) VALUES (#{chatRoomId}, #{userId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_room_user WHERE chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chat_room_user WHERE chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT chat_room_id AS chatRoomId, title, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, last_at AS lastAt FROM chat_room WHERE chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId};
SELECT chat_room_id AS chatRoomId, title, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, last_at AS lastAt FROM chat_room ORDER BY last_at DESC;

SELECT cr.chat_room_id AS chatRoomId, cr.title, cr.last_at AS lastAt, COALESCE(cr.user_nickname, '익명') AS userNickname, COALESCE(cr.user_profile, '/default-profile.png') AS userProfile FROM chat_room cr WHERE cr.place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY cr.last_at DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT cr.chat_room_id AS chatRoomId, cr.title, cr.created_at AS createdAt, cr.updated_at AS updatedAt, cr.last_at AS lastAt, cr.user_nickname AS userNickname, cr.user_profile AS userProfile, ( SELECT message FROM chat_history ch WHERE ch.chat_room_id = cr.chat_room_id ORDER BY ch.send_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS lastMessage, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_history ch WHERE ch.chat_room_id = cr.chat_room_id AND ch.send_date > IFNULL(( SELECT cru.last_read_at FROM chat_room_user cru WHERE cru.chat_room_id = cr.chat_room_id AND cru.user_id = #{userId} ), '1970-01-01') ) AS unreadCount FROM chat_room cr LEFT JOIN chat_room_user cru ON cr.chat_room_id = cru.chat_room_id WHERE cru.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY cr.last_at DESC
